uk_news.headline: Starmer rules out austerity as Labour conference opens
uk_news.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has ruled out a return to austerity as the Labour Party conference opens, using the set-piece to try to steady his leadership after a turbulent summer of resignations and internal pressure over the direction of the government.

uk_news.headline: Government commits £442m to offer every rough sleeper a route indoors by Christmas
uk_news.summary: Labour says it will offer every person sleeping rough a route indoors by Christmas, backed by £442 million of extra funding, as ministers push a run of domestic-policy announcements to reset the political narrative.

uk_news.headline: Starmer stays on as PM but Labour trails Reform UK amid lingering leadership questions
uk_news.summary: Keir Starmer remains in Downing Street after surviving the spring leadership crisis, but Labour continues to trail Reform UK in the polls following heavy local-election losses, keeping questions over his long-term position alive within the party.

zimbabwe_news.headline: Mnangagwa vows to turn Zimbabwe from raw-material exporter into a local processor
zimbabwe_news.summary: President Mnangagwa said his administration is committed to transforming Zimbabwe from a raw-material exporter into an economy that processes its resources locally, promising government support for local industries and partnerships to lift the country's participation in global value chains.

zimbabwe_news.headline: Tourism investment surges 229% to US$132m in the first half of 2026
zimbabwe_news.summary: Zimbabwe's tourism sector recorded US$132.3 million of investment in the first half of 2026, a 229% jump on the same period in 2025, with the country picking up recognition from Forbes, Condé Nast and a Gold Award at the 2026 Chinese Tourist Welcome Awards.

zimbabwe_news.headline: Mnangagwa pledges economic-empowerment support for local industry
zimbabwe_news.summary: President Mnangagwa pledged to facilitate economic empowerment and back the establishment of local industries, framing beneficiation and value addition as central to his second-term economic programme.

zimbabwe_news.headline: Constitutional Amendment Bill to extend terms to seven years draws opposition
zimbabwe_news.summary: A Constitutional Amendment Bill gazetted earlier in 2026 proposes extending presidential and parliamentary terms from five to seven years, drawing continued opposition from civil society, legal groups and human-rights organisations who warn it could entrench incumbency.

ai_news.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra with a 1M-token context window
ai_news.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, featuring a roughly 1.05M-token context and 128K output, at standard pricing of about $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output, extending the frontier at the top end of the model market.

ai_news.headline: Anthropic ships Fable 5.1 with cheaper cache reads and big science-benchmark gains
ai_news.summary: Anthropic made Fable 5.1 generally available on 1 September at the same $10/$50 pricing as Fable 5, with cache reads dropping to $0.25 and a self-reported Terminal-Bench-Science score of 52.6 versus Fable 5's 24.7.

ai_news.headline: 100+ tech firms including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google urge action against rogue-AI cyber threats
ai_news.summary: More than a hundred technology companies — among them OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Microsoft — signed an open letter urging the public and private sectors to work together to defend against AI-related cyber threats.

ai_news.headline: Anthropic commits roughly $80bn to compute
ai_news.summary: Anthropic has committed on the order of $80 billion to compute capacity, underscoring the scale of infrastructure spending now required to train and serve frontier models as demand for Claude continues to grow.

ai_news.headline: Google DeepMind maps 9 billion DNA variants
ai_news.summary: Google DeepMind reported mapping around 9 billion DNA variants, applying AI to genomics at a scale intended to accelerate research into disease and drug discovery.

ai_news.headline: Anthropic publishes September threat-intelligence report on disrupted AI misuse
ai_news.summary: Anthropic published its September threat-intelligence report, detailing misuse of its models it disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026 and outlining the detection and enforcement measures applied.

Rugby.headline: United Rugby Championship 2026-27 kicks off with Leinster defending back-to-back titles
Rugby.summary: The 2026-27 United Rugby Championship gets under way on 19 September, running through to June 2027. Reigning champions Leinster — the first side to go back-to-back in the URC era — begin the defence of a title they sealed by beating the Bulls 36-7 at Croke Park.

Rugby.headline: All Blacks' eight-match South Africa tour wraps up, with the fourth Test staged in Baltimore
Rugby.summary: New Zealand's rare extended tour of South Africa — eight matches including four Tests against the Springboks — has concluded, the fourth Test taking the fixture overseas to M&T Bank Stadium in Baltimore as the sides experiment with the international calendar.

Cricket.headline: Australia tour Zimbabwe for three ODIs in Harare, starting 15 September
Cricket.summary: Australia are in Zimbabwe for a three-match ODI series at Harare Sports Club on 15, 18 and 20 September, a marquee home series for the hosts and a chance to test themselves against one of the world's top sides on home soil.

Cricket.headline: Series guide: Zimbabwe v Australia ODIs — 15, 18 and 20 September at Harare Sports Club
Cricket.summary: Cricket Australia's series guide previews the three ODIs in Harare, with start times, squads and broadcast details, as Australia continue a busy sub-continent-and-Africa block of white-ball cricket.

Football World Cup.headline: Champions recap: Spain won the 2026 World Cup, beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time
Football World Cup.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup, co-hosted by the US, Mexico and Canada, was won by Spain, who beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the New York/New Jersey final on 19 July, with Ferran Torres scoring the winner for Spain's second world title.

Football World Cup.headline: FIFA emerged a ~$9bn winner as the expanded 48-team World Cup wrapped up
Football World Cup.summary: With the expanded 48-team tournament concluded, FIFA emerged as an estimated $9 billion financial winner, closing the biggest and most commercial World Cup in the event's history as attention turns to club football and the next qualifying cycle.
